{{Top}}
[[File:SithAlchemy-BOS.jpg|thumb|A Sith alchemist.]]
{{Quote|Freedon Nadd said that Naga Sadow was a Sith ''alchemist''&hellip;he knew secrets ''beyond'' the powers of the Jedi.|[[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]]|<ref name="DarkLords4">[[Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith 4|''Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith'' 4]]</ref>}}
A '''Sith alchemist''' was a practitioner of [[Sith alchemy/Legends|Sith alchemy]]. Those who used it relied on [[Sith sorcery/Legends|Sith sorcery]] to make all sorts of creations of the dark side,<ref name="DSB">''[[The Dark Side Sourcebook]]''</ref> such as the [[Mask (Sith Alchemy)|Mask technique]]<ref name="Jedi Counseling 71">[[Jedi Counseling]] 71, [[Wizards of the Coast]] [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]] website [https://web.archive.org/web/20090602013752/http://www.wizards.com/default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20050804jc71 (link)]''</ref> and [[Sithspawn/Legends|Sithspawn]].<ref name="DSB" /> Famous Sith alchemists include [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]], creator of the mutated [[Massassi/Legends|Massassi]] and [[Sith wyrm]],<ref name="DarkLords4" /> [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]], creator of [[Terentatek/Legends|Terentateks]] and [[Battle hydra/Legends|Battle hydras]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> and [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], author of the ''[[Dark Side Compendium]]''.<ref name="DSB" />
